correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs quadratic Gauss identity and exact coefficient formula (1) for every a,b in V. It establishes positivity for m>=2, decomposes symmetric and skew Weyl indices, and uses character orthogonality to derive every singular value, rank and condition number with exact norm conventions. The standalone exact integer checker reproduces every signed coefficient for both Gauss signs at dimensions 4,6,8 and full symmetric modular projector rank at dimension 4; finite examples are not substituted for the analytic all-dimensional argument.
